Record Class ThemeDefinition

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.theme.ThemeDefinition
Record Components:
name - theme name shown in the selector
description - optional author guidance
palette - named colors that can be reused by several roles
colors - semantic roles, such as button.background
rules - menu and element overrides in declaration order
public record ThemeDefinition(String name, String description, Map<String,String> palette, Map<String,String> colors, List<ThemeDefinition.Rule> rules) extends Record
A UI theme shared by the Minecraft client and the standalone Theme Creator.

Colors are #RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or palette references such as $primary. A theme inherits omitted colors and palette entries from default_theme. Rules can override a color for a particular menu or control without copying the rest of the theme.
